comment: apply.c jump(), leaving a web and lava (lines 2093-2109 for the lava case): a Knight in debug mode steps off the stairs, wishes for a web under himself, steps away and back into it, and #jumps a knight's move out of it, tearing the web; he then puts on a wished-for ring of fire resistance, wishes for lava under himself (he sinks in but is only slightly burned) and #jumps again, which pulls him above the lava in place. Sunk in again, he zaps a wished-for wand of cold downward, which freezes the lava around his legs, and #jumps once more, which only strains his legs (the TT_INFLOOR case). Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
